item.title: The Mystery Of Jesus
item.description: The Mystery Of Jesus is not found in doctrine, miracles, or history, but in silent presence. Jesus revealed a state of consciousness where separation dissolves and love becomes seeing. His message was not belief, but awakening—an invitation to recognize the same divine presence within ourselves.

item.title: Why Humanity Needs Philosopher-Gods, Not Religion
item.description: This essay reframes the philosophy of religion by arguing that humans do not need institutional dogma or absolute truth, but philosopher-gods who offer existential orientation within the limits of consciousness. Drawing from existentialism, psychology, and cognitive science, it shows how meaning, mental health, and wisdom arise from embracing paradox, uncertainty, and adaptive ignorance.
